scripts.build: npm run build:site && npm run build:builder
scripts.build:site: npm run type-check && vite build && node scripts/check-build.mjs site
scripts.build:builder: npm run type-check:builder && vite build --config vite.builder.config.ts && node scripts/check-build.mjs builder
scripts.build:site:staging: npm run type-check && vite build --mode staging && node scripts/check-build.mjs site
scripts.build:builder:staging: npm run type-check:builder && vite build --config vite.builder.config.ts --mode staging && node scripts/check-build.mjs builder
scripts.build:staging: npm run build:site:staging && npm run build:builder:staging
scripts.deploy:builder: npm run build:builder && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.builder.jsonc
scripts.test: tsx --test src/*.test.ts scripts/*.test.mjs && npm run test:web -w @canopy/voice && npm run test:web -w @canopy/vibe && npm run test:web -w @canopy/linux && npm test -w @canopy/example-message-board
